name: Canvas API
description: Integrates Instructure's Canvas LMS REST API with Drupal via a chainable service (method + path + params).
project_description: Canvas API integrates Instructure's Canvas LMS REST API with Drupal. The 2.x branch pares the module down to a single chainable service, canvas_api, that takes an HTTP method, a relative API path, and parameters, then performs the authenticated request and returns the decoded JSON. It depends on the canvas_lms module (which supplies the institution subdomain and environment: production, test, or beta) and on the Key module (which supplies the Canvas access token). The base URL is assembled as https://<institution>[.test|.beta].instructure.com/api/v1/. GET requests are auto-paginated by following the rel="next" Link header up to a fail-safe of 50 pages. An admin-only tester form at /admin/reports/canvas_api lets you issue ad-hoc calls. Example: \Drupal::service('canvas_api')->setMethod('GET')->setPath('courses/sis_course_id:3456/users')->request().
